title.narrative: Socio-economic capacity building for vulnerable households - as part of exit period activities

description.narrative: As part of CAFOD International programme refocusing process, Burundi was one of the countries that CAFOD decided to stop its programs. The next step of the exit strategy was to get in touch with partners in order to review their current joint pieces of work and together to set up priorities and design an action plan in light of the planned changes. This includes any outstanding communication issues, the identification of change management processes and support needed by them, and the development of a sensible exit strategy, among other things. As part of this process, the current three years programme with our ODDBU partner, which is in the second year of implementation, was reviewed, and some additional activities have been identified in order to reach the objectives of the program and also to match with the exit strategy priorities. The main objective of the additional activities is to train the governmental agronomists so they will continue the monitoring and support to beneficiaries after CAFOD withdrawal. The other objective is to set up local monitoring committee in each village where activities are implemented, so beneficiaries are able to support each other, in sharing experiences.
